forecast.formula: snapshot pending / prior annual outcomes * 365; end-2027 = B(1 July 2026) + 3 * H1 growth
caveats: Stock/flow arithmetic is not an observed wait, an expected individual wait, or a predictive probability.
Requires comparable scope, constant throughput and counting, no priority effects and a defined queue order. Dynamic arrivals, rework, category changes and MOS can invalidate it.
Calling pending counts an upper bound is not established: a possible counting problem does not prove its direction.
Five-year lag of application totals is not a longitudinal cohort model: repeats, departures, legal-residence periods and eligibility are unobserved.
No confidence interval, probability calibration or validation of forecast accuracy.
